crossRefs.note: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the…
being only (with meats and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.
For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices…
So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.
But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and…
wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves…
without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the…
for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
(for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore…
But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.
Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever…

and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.

translations.web: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;
translations.bsb: one who has become a priest not by a law of succession, but by the power of an indestructible life.
translations.kjv: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
translations.asv: who hath been made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life:
